full_hour_counts.interpretation: Window creation counts across all ingress and attempts. Checkpoint outcomes describe exact completed cohort; latest attempt and effect ownership verified separately.

applied_Form_canonical_transactions.method: Up to forty change records bounded by ObjectId; direct channel verified, exact change provenance to Decision and Observation and receipt, same-entity jobs and job/run attempts, exact Daily Operations dedupe keys. A five-second projected oplog query tests whether the Lead update, change, Decision and Sheet job share one applyOps entry. No customer field values, job numbers or private identifiers returned.

sealed_plan_lower_bound.method: For each exact system-approved selected terminal run, max(0, ceil(N/25)-1) additional sealed-plan claims times BSON size P. Excludes first planning/possible apply. Counterfactual logical plan subdocuments only; not actual wire/physical traffic, replies, changes in total network or service costs.
